name: @probabl/pi-ask-user-question
description: Pi extension. Structured questionnaire tool (ask_user_question) that scales past 4 questions and 4 options — fork of @juicesharp/rpiv-ask-user-question with configurable question/option caps, a windowed tab bar and scrolling option lists.
